name: GitHub Secure Open Source Fund
description: Provides funding and Azure credits to support security work in open source projects.
eligibility_notes: Open to open source projects that improve software security. Direct application process.

name: Alpha-Omega
description: An associated project of OpenSSF focused on protecting critical open source software ecosystem-wide.
eligibility_notes: Direct application for grants to support security improvements across open source software ecosystems.

name: FLOSS/fund
description: Zerodha's fund for free/libre and open source software. Any country. Accepts funding.json manifests.
eligibility_notes: Submit a funding.json manifest or list your project in their open directory.

name: Sovereign Tech Fund
description: German government-backed fund for critical digital infrastructure and digital sovereignty.
eligibility_notes: Direct application for projects critical to open digital infrastructure and commons.

name: Python Software Foundation Grants
description: Grants for projects, events, and initiatives that benefit the global Python community and ecosystem.
eligibility_notes: Rolling application process. Must directly benefit Python or the Python ecosystem.

name: NumFOCUS
description: Non-profit providing fiscal sponsorship and grants for open source scientific computing software.
eligibility_notes: Direct application for projects focused on scientific computing and data science.

name: Open Technology Fund — Internet Freedom Fund
description: Grants supporting internet freedom, privacy, and anti-censorship open source tools.
eligibility_notes: Scope-restricted to internet freedom/censorship-circumvention tools, not general OSS.

name: NLnet Foundation
description: European foundation funding open internet, privacy, and digital rights technology.
eligibility_notes: Calls closed until Sept 3, 2026. Focus on internet privacy, open standards, and digital commons.

name: Prototype Fund (Germany)
description: German public fund supporting innovative open source software prototypes by small teams and individuals.
eligibility_notes: Germany residency required for lead applicant; application window Oct-Nov only.

name: Chan Zuckerberg Initiative — Essential OSS for Science
description: Grants for open source software essential to scientific and biomedical research.
eligibility_notes: Letter of Intent (LOI) submission. Supports essential open source scientific and biomedical tools.

name: Spotify FOSS Fund
description: Spotify's open source fund distributing €100,000/year across projects used by Spotify engineers.
eligibility_notes: Nominated by Spotify employees. Not a direct application.

name: Microsoft FOSS Fund
description: Microsoft's quarterly fund distributing ~$12,500/quarter to open source projects used by Microsoft.
eligibility_notes: Nominated by Microsoft employees. Internal nomination process.

name: Bloomberg FOSS Contributor Fund
description: Bloomberg's contributor fund providing $10,000 grants to open source projects used internally.
eligibility_notes: Nominated by Bloomberg open source contributors and engineers.
